activeSkills.name: Liên Hoa Phiến
activeSkills.definition: Several rapid frontal fan hits; melee.
activeSkills.visual: Short layered fan-shaped wind crescents closely following the open fan across a shallow FRONTAL sector. Separate sequential sweeps, not a ring or ranged volley.
poses: Anticipation: open fan drawn back across chest, compact planted stance.
Action: rapid fan slash with a few distinct shallow forward fan-edge echoes, feet planted, face and fan readable.
Recovery: right hand returns fan to guard, small local contact wisps fade.
activeSkills.stages: Near-hand activation wisp -> successive short frontal air arcs -> tiny close contact flicks -> clear fade; no detached projectiles.
activeSkills.icon: An ivory OPEN FAN with THREE short nested forward crescents; broad fan ribs remain dominant. Distinguish from single normal fan icon by the triple arc rhythm.

activeSkills.name: Lục Dương Chưởng
activeSkills.definition: Moving spinning attack with repeated nearby damage.
activeSkills.visual: Compact low broken wind ring around the feet/waist, following a turning hero and a short continuous ground path. Fan stays in the right hand. Open ring segments, never a tall tornado.
poses: Anticipation: knees bend, fan across body to wind up rotation.
Action: turn on a grounded foot, robe hem flares, open fan sweeps around a close broken wind ring; one intermediate turning pose visible as a small sequence inset.
Recovery: finish the turn facing forward, ring breaks into short curling wisps.
activeSkills.stages: Gather at fan -> close waist/foot spin moving with hero -> local contact swirls -> dissolve. Show nearby footprint; no pull, stun or stationary zone.
activeSkills.icon: Low circular spiral seen from above with a tiny ivory fan tip and open center. A compact ROUND ring, distinct from the tall ultimate funnel.

activeSkills.name: Lưu Phong Bộ
activeSkills.visual: A short forward ground dash with parallel tapering air streaks trailing BEHIND the planted arrival pose, fluttering ribbons, one restrained translucent prior-position silhouette as temporal echo. No attack arcs or impacts.
poses: Anticipation: lower weight toward front foot, fan carried at side.
Action: short forward step-dash to the right with one pale trailing temporal afterimage connected by air wisps; feet stay over the ground plane.
Recovery: regain upright guard with fan visible, trail thins behind heels.
activeSkills.stages: Lean -> continuous directional travel along short path -> settle/fade. No teleport portal, no slash, no contact hit, no invulnerability cue.
activeSkills.icon: A small DARK SHOE/heel silhouette riding THREE parallel tapered horizontal wind streaks. A movement icon with NO blade or fan crescent.

activeSkills.name: Chiết Mai Thủ
activeSkills.visual: A brief jade-white pulse at wrist and ankles, then TWO short restrained separate wrist/heel wisps. Tiny accents only; no full-body shield/bubble, no outgoing attack and no giant persistent aura.
poses: Anticipation: fan held right, left hand forms a refined two-finger gesture near collar.
Activation: compact flash at right wrist and heels, ribbons lift slightly with a fresh breeze.
Sustained/recovery: return to relaxed fan guard with only two sparse short wrist/ankle wisps; also show feedback fading cleanly.
activeSkills.stages: Buff activation -> restrained temporary sustained feedback at wrists/heels -> clean expiration. No damage/target impact, no cooldown/cost/duration claims.
activeSkills.icon: A refined TWO-FINGER HAND gesture framed by two rising wind commas/small speed ticks. No flower petals, frost, shield or clock text.

activeSkills.name: Bách Phiến Phong Bạo
activeSkills.visual: A larger OPEN, low-to-mid-height WIND HELIX anchored on and moving WITH the hero. Ivory fan-leaf-shaped air ribbons suggest revolving fan edges. Hero's face/feet stay visible through the open center. Visually larger than close spin, not screen-filling.
poses: Anticipation: fan raised outward in a deliberate wide grounded stance.
Action: broad layered broken wind helix wraps around hero at three-quarter ground angle, one clear open fan in hand; sweeping silk/air blades do not detach into missiles.
Recovery: helix unwraps into thinning ribbon ends and the hero settles to guard.
activeSkills.stages: Fan gather -> expanding open helix -> continuous moving whirlwind footprint -> local fade. No suction/pull/lift, projectile volley, launched tornado or extra movement distance/range claims.
activeSkills.icon: A TALL OPEN SPIRAL/FUNNEL with clearly recognizable ivory folding-fan ribs along its lower rim, hollow center. Larger dynamic silhouette than compact Lục Dương ring.

activeSkills.name: Phi Ảnh Trảm
activeSkills.definition: Forward dash with a hard slash.
activeSkills.visual: A single continuous forward body dash followed by ONE bold diagonal CLOSE blade crescent at arrival. Narrow trailing wind behind; contact flash tied to blade edge.
poses: Anticipation: curved dao chambered behind the right shoulder, weight ready to travel forward.
Action: grounded rightward dash into one forceful close slash; one subtle trail marks prior position and a solid crescent stays ATTACHED to the blade reach.
Recovery: stop in a braced landing stance, blade low, trailing air expires.
activeSkills.stages: Windup -> offensive dash -> one close-contact slash -> recovery. No teleportation, ranged blade wave, stun, enlarged strike reach or additional hits.
activeSkills.icon: ONE diagonal curved SILVER BLADE at the leading end of straight trailing wind streaks. Clear attack-and-forward-motion silhouette; distinct from shoe-only dash.

activeSkills.name: Truy Hồn Đao
activeSkills.definition: Two quick hits, with bonus damage against slowed targets.
activeSkills.visual: Two distinct successive close dao cuts with different angles, drawn in two SEPARATE action sub-panels to make temporal sequence unambiguous. A faint existing dull foot-wisp on a neutral target may signify an already-slowed target, never newly applied slow.
poses: Anticipation: compact right-hand dao guard.
Action: TWO adjacent temporal cells labelled HIT 1 then HIT 2, first rising oblique cut and second descending cut; each has one short blade-attached air arc.
Recovery: withdraw dao to ready, two local contact wisps have faded.
activeSkills.stages: First close cut -> distinct second close cut -> clear fade. Bonus vs previously slowed target is a condition only; no new slow/CC/debuff inflicted, no lifesteal, no homing.
activeSkills.icon: TWO separate curved SILVER CUT marks in an offset double-diagonal rhythm, two distinct not crossed into a defensive shield. No skulls or tracking arrow.

activeSkills.name: Phong Ảnh Hoán Vị
activeSkills.definition: Evasive short step with a timed counter window.
activeSkills.visual: A small oblique SIDE step, one thin residual silhouette at previous footing, then a poised right-hand curved-dao guard with a tiny broken hook/comma of wind near the hilt. Counter-branch sketch is conditional, not guaranteed damage.
poses: Anticipation: dao drawn into a compact guard.
Action: short diagonal evasive step off the old line, continuous tiny ground trail, one faint prior-position echo.
Counter-ready/recovery: settled guard with one subtle hilt wisp; show two small branch insets: conditional short counter-cut if triggered, and clean fade if no trigger.
activeSkills.stages: Evasive step -> brief counter-ready cue -> conditional melee counter OR expiry. No swapped enemy positions, teleport, clone/summon, shield, invulnerability bubble or new target selection.
activeSkills.icon: A curved SILVER GUARD/BLADE with a single hooked RETURN wind stroke and an offset faint short echo. A bent/returning motif distinct from straight offensive dash and two-hit diagonal pair.

activeSkills.name: Liệt Phong Đao
activeSkills.definition: One heavy strike with partial defense penetration.
activeSkills.visual: One heavy compressed close sword-edge slash, a dense short wind wedge concentrated at CONTACT, a small generic plate/guard outline the edge PARTLY passes through as a penetration metaphor. No persistent broken-shield debuff mark.
poses: Anticipation: grounded heavy stance with curved dao lifted over the right shoulder.
Action: one forceful downward-forward close strike, single thick sharp tapered air wedge hugs blade and a tight local contact flash.
Recovery: blade finishes low, compressed air breaks into two small wisps then clears.
activeSkills.stages: Heavy windup -> ONE penetrating contact stroke -> compact impact -> fade. Partial defense penetration only: not defense reduction, armor destruction, ranged projectile, shockwave, stun or ground rupture.
activeSkills.icon: ONE thick downward diagonal SILVER blade edge with a short compressed wedge crossing a small partial plate outline. Single forceful stroke; no broken-shield debuff emblem.

activeSkills.name: Bách Liệt Thiên Kích
activeSkills.definition: Extremely fast forward melee combo; ultimate.
activeSkills.visual: A rapid forward-oriented melee flurry of MANY short blade-edge strokes concentrated just ahead of the hero, ending in one readable close finishing cut. Negative-space gaps between slashes; subtle arm/weapon temporal echoes, no arena-wide cyclone.
poses: Anticipation: low coiled dao stance and gathered narrow wind at the arm.
Action: quick forward melee flurry shown as a strip of three temporal key moments with dense but separated SHORT local blade strokes; hero remains visible and grounded.
Recovery/finisher: one clearly readable close finishing cut, then controlled guard with effects dissipating.
activeSkills.stages: Coil -> rapid forward local multi-cut sequence -> final close cut -> dissipation. No teleport jumps, extra dash ability, tracking projectiles, huge ranged sword-beam, exact hit-count/timing/range claim or new crowd control.
activeSkills.icon: A tight forward CLUSTER of FIVE short sharp silver slash ticks with one strong terminal stroke. A compact multi-strike burst, distinct from two-cut Truy Hồn and single Liệt Phong.

additionalIcons.name: Thiên Sơn Phiến
additionalIcons.definition: Normal fan melee attack; reuse approved character animation.
additionalIcons.icon: ONE clean ivory open folding combat FAN, dark jade ribs and edge, a SINGLE tiny near-edge wind accent. No flurry/triple arcs; fan silhouette dominates.

additionalIcons.name: Thiên Sơn Đao
additionalIcons.definition: Normal curved dao melee attack; reuse approved character animation.
additionalIcons.icon: ONE simple curved SILVER Chinese DAO with jade handle and silver guard on a clear diagonal. No dash streaks or multi-cut flurry; blade silhouette dominates.

additionalIcons.name: Bắc Minh Thần Công
additionalIcons.definition: Innate movement/attack-speed/crit growth; icon only. No persistent aura proposed.
additionalIcons.icon: A centered JADE DISC/MEDALLION holding a hollow S-shaped WHITE WIND CURRENT and a small silver pinpoint. Balanced quiet internal-energy emblem; no Yin-Yang dots, snowflake, shield or active slash.
